Class PlayerLeaveArenaEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.despical.kotl.api.events.KOTLEvent
dev.despical.kotl.api.events.player.PlayerEvent
dev.despical.kotl.api.events.player.PlayerLeaveArenaEvent
public class PlayerLeaveArenaEvent extends PlayerEvent
Called immediately before a player is removed from a KOTL arena.

The player is still registered in the game when this event is fired. Arena membership, statistics, inventory state, scoreboards, and boss bars are therefore still available to listeners.

This event is informational and is not cancellable. The PlayerLeaveArenaEvent.LeaveReason identifies whether the removal came from normal movement, death, disconnection, administration, or game shutdown.

Since:
2.7.9
